name: smwmusic-alcahest-a-world-without-soul-the-demon-underworld-remix
title: Alcahest - A World without Soul ~ The Demon Underworld (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of The Demon Underworld from Alcahest. Seriously, for an obscure (but really awesome) Super-Famicom-Only Action RPG by HAL, Jun Ishikawa went hard on this OST. This soundtrack feels like a blend of Ishikawa's style in Kirby Super Star with Nobuo Uematsu's style in the SNES Final Fantasy games. It's easily my favorite Kirby soundtrack given its style and the compositions here.

Originally was planning on doing Panakeian Castle, but I thought I'd give a spotlight to the heavily underrated endgame stage theme 'cuz it's amazing. What's with Squaresoft games having amazing endgame themes anyways?

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Japanese Goblin Pitch)
3. D Minor (Custom Pitch)
